title: Kirby and the World Beyond Revealed for Switch 2 — New 3D Adventure Launches Spring 2027
description: Nintendo has revealed Kirby and the World Beyond, a new 3D Kirby adventure for Nintendo Switch 2 launching in spring 2027 with expansive exploration and powered-up Copy Abilities.
body:
Nintendo has officially revealed **Kirby and the World Beyond**, a brand-new 3D Kirby adventure coming to **Nintendo Switch 2 in spring 2027**.

Rather than presenting another tightly segmented platforming journey, Nintendo is emphasizing a broader sense of freedom. Kirby can move through expansive 3D environments and use familiar Copy Abilities not only in combat, but as tools for traversal and exploration.

The reveal also introduces a mysterious girl with unusual powers, a huge wall blocking Kirby’s path and a familiar antagonist in King Dedede — all of which suggest the new adventure is building a larger mystery around whatever lies beyond the world Kirby currently knows.
author: Rouane Mounssif
imageAlt: Kirby stands in a colorful landscape beneath the Kirby and the World Beyond logo.

contentBlocks.text: Nintendo confirmed that **Kirby and the World Beyond is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in spring 2027**. The timing is notable because 2027 marks the Kirby series’ 35th anniversary, giving Nintendo a major new entry to anchor the celebration rather than relying only on remasters or anniversary content.
contentBlocks.caption: Kirby explores a bright 3D environment filled with enemies and open paths in Kirby and the World Beyond.
contentBlocks.heading: Kirby and the World Beyond launches in spring 2027
contentBlocks.imageAlt: Kirby moves through a grassy 3D area with enemies and a city skyline in the distance.
contentBlocks.subtitle: Nintendo

contentBlocks.text: Nintendo describes the game as letting players **freely explore an expansive world**. That wording is important. The reveal clearly shows broader 3D spaces than the compact stages associated with much of Kirby’s past, but Nintendo has not formally called the game open world. Until the company explains how its regions connect, it is safer to describe World Beyond as a more expansive 3D Kirby rather than assume a seamless open-world structure.
contentBlocks.heading: Nintendo is promising a more freely explorable 3D world

contentBlocks.text: The biggest mechanical change shown so far is how Kirby’s Copy Abilities interact with the environment. Nintendo says Kirby can use **bomb jumps to launch himself upward**, stick a sword into trees and climb, and move at high speed across fields. That gives familiar powers a second purpose: they are no longer just ways to defeat enemies, but part of how Kirby navigates and discovers the world.
contentBlocks.heading: Copy Abilities now double as traversal tools

contentBlocks.text: Nintendo specifically describes Kirby’s powers as **powered-up Copy Abilities**, and the reveal footage shows abilities taking on much more dramatic forms. The exact progression system has not been explained yet, so it is unclear whether these transformations are permanent upgrades, temporary states or something tied to the game’s story. What is clear is that World Beyond wants Copy Abilities to feel more transformative than simple combat swaps.
contentBlocks.caption: A powered-up Kirby ability sends him streaking forward in one of the reveal trailer’s most dramatic sequences.
contentBlocks.heading: Powered-up abilities could be the game’s defining new system
contentBlocks.imageAlt: Kirby uses a glowing powered-up ability while moving at high speed through a dark environment.
contentBlocks.subtitle: Nintendo

contentBlocks.text: Nintendo’s official description says Kirby will encounter a **mysterious girl with unusual powers** and eventually rescue her from King Dedede. Nintendo has not named her or explained her connection to the strange power Kirby gains, making her one of the biggest unanswered questions after the reveal.
contentBlocks.heading: A mysterious girl sits at the center of the new story

contentBlocks.text: The title is not just decorative. Nintendo repeatedly draws attention to a **huge wall blocking Kirby’s path** and asks what waits on the other side. That makes the boundary itself part of the premise: Kirby is exploring a seemingly contained world, gaining new ways to move through it and eventually pushing beyond a barrier that appears designed to keep something separated.
contentBlocks.heading: The giant wall gives World Beyond its central mystery

contentBlocks.text: King Dedede appears in the game’s official story setup as the one holding the mysterious girl. That establishes him as an immediate obstacle, but Kirby games have a long history of complicating Dedede’s apparent villain role. Nintendo has not said whether he is the primary antagonist, acting under outside influence or simply part of a larger conflict.
contentBlocks.heading: King Dedede is back, but Nintendo is keeping his role vague

contentBlocks.text: **Kirby and the Forgotten Land** proved that Kirby could transition naturally into full 3D spaces. World Beyond appears to push that idea further by giving movement abilities more environmental utility and placing greater emphasis on freely traversing large areas. The reveal does not yet tell us how large the game is, but its design language suggests Nintendo and HAL Laboratory are treating 3D Kirby as a foundation to expand rather than a one-off experiment.
contentBlocks.heading: World Beyond looks like the next step after Forgotten Land

quickRead: Kirby and the World Beyond launches for Nintendo Switch 2 in spring 2027.
Nintendo describes the game as a 3D adventure built around freely exploring an expansive world.
Copy Abilities now have traversal uses, while powered-up versions appear to play a major role.
The story introduces a mysterious girl, King Dedede and a giant wall hiding whatever lies beyond Kirby’s world.
conclusion: Kirby’s first major Switch 2 adventure is already doing more than simply moving Forgotten Land onto larger maps. **World Beyond is turning Copy Abilities into exploration tools and building its story around the idea of crossing a boundary.** The unanswered questions — who the mysterious girl is, what changed Kirby’s powers and what exists beyond the enormous wall — give Nintendo plenty left to reveal before spring 2027.
conclusionHeading: Kirby is going bigger — but the world beyond the wall is still the real mystery
